'''AL1-L3''', nicknamed "'''Allie'''," was a [[protocol droid]] that served in the administrative center of the [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]]. After witnessing a [[Raid on Kessel|droid revolution]] sparked by the droid [[L3-37]] in [[10 BBY]], AL1-L3 saw a glimpse of independence that survived in the back of her [[processor]]s when she was later scrapped and recycled.

AL1-L3 slowly rebuilt herself and began to work as a cargo hauler for [[droid]] clientele. By [[2 BBY]], she had joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and was part of the [[Massassi Group]] based on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. By [[34 ABY]], her [[Smuggler|smuggling]] work had resulted in a [[bounty]] being placed on her head, and while she was hiding in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the planet Batuu, her location was reported to the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]].

In [[35 ABY]], she heeded the call of L3-37's old allies [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca]] to aid the [[Resistance]] in [[Battle of Exegol|defeating]] [[Darth Sidious]] and the [[Sith Eternal]] on the planet [[Exegol]]. After the Resistance and its allies emerged victorious, AL1-L3 returned to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the moon [[Ajan Kloss]] to celebrate.

==Biography==
===Inspiration on Kessel===
[[File:L3-2.jpg|thumb|left|300px|alt=L3-37 pumps her fist in the air during the uprising on Kessel.|AL1-L3 was inspired by L3-37's (pictured) uprising on Kessel.]]
AL1-L3 started out as a [[protocol droid]] with<ref name="TROS VD" /> [[Gender|feminine programming]]<ref name="Art" /> who was forced to work in the administrative center<ref name="TROS VD" /> of the criminal [[Pyke Syndicate]]'s<ref name="SoloOG">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> [[Spice mines of Kessel|spice mines]] on the [[planet]] [[Kessel]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> where<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> she<ref name="TROS VD" /> had been manufactured.<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Kessel date" /> she witnessed an [[Slavery|enslaved]] and [[droid]] [[Raid on Kessel|uprising]] within the [[Mining|mine]] led by the self-made droid<ref name="TROS VD" /> [[L3-37]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> Shortly afterward, AL1-L3 was scrapped for disobedience and recycled, but she slowly rebuilt herself over the [[Standard decade|decades]] and gained more independence.<ref name="TROS VD" />

Going by AL1-L3 or "Allie," she began operating as a cargo hauler for exclusively droid clientele and was at some point supplied with a [[cape]] by the [[Droid Gotra]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> By [[2 BBY]],<ref name="MessengerDate">{{AndorDate|207}}</ref> AL1-L3 had joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in opposing the [[Galactic Empire]] and was part of<ref name="Andor" /> the [[Massassi Group]]<ref name="Massassi" /> based out of the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="ROUVG">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> That [[Standard year|year]], she walked through one of the temple's [[hangar]]s<ref name="Andor" /> while it was under construction,<ref name="AndorAD">{{Andor|Messenger}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> passing [[General]] [[Davits Draven]] as she moved further into the structure.<ref name="Andor" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="MakeItStopDate">{{AndorDate|1B}}</ref> AL1-L3 was still on Yavin 4 with the rebels and carried out repair works<ref name="WhoElseKnows">{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}}</ref> with two other [[Technician|mechanics]]<ref name="WhoElseKnowsAD">{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> on a blue-striped [[X-wing starfighter]] atop a landing pad outside the temple.<ref name="WhoElseKnows" /> She was later working on a piece of machinery on top of some crates inside one of the temple's hangars when air-raid sirens began sounding to warn of an approaching rebel [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft|U-wing]] making an unauthorized landing.<ref name="Jedha">{{Andor|Who Else Knows?}}</ref>

[[File:AL1-L3-Yavin-Messenger.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=In one of the Great Temple of Yavin's hangars, General Davits Draven strides past AL1-L3 as she walks in the opposite direction away from the hangar opening.|AL1-L3 joined the Rebellion against the Empire.]]
During the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the planet [[Batuu]]<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="GEDates">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]], which include ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', to [[34 ABY]].</ref> there was an outstanding [[bounty]] of 1300 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] on AL1-L3 for disobedience, evading arrest, illegal reprogramming and rebuilding, and [[Smuggler|smuggling]] droid clientele. While AL1-L3 was hiding in one of the buildings of [[Black Spire Outpost]] on Batuu, a visitor to the outpost was assigned her bounty by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. They discovered her location using a [[thermal scanner]], which they then reported to the local [[Guildmaster's Hideout]] before collecting the bounty.<ref name="Bounty Hunters" />

===Exegol and aftermath===
{{Quote|''This is'' General Lando Calrissian''. If you're listening to this broadcast… you're our'' last hope.|italics=0|Lando Calrissian recruits AL1-L3 and many others for the Citizens' Fleet|<ref name="TROS5">[[The Rise of Skywalker Adaptation 5|''The Rise of Skywalker Adaptation'' 5]]</ref>}}
In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> AL1-L3 was one of the many unaffiliated [[pilot]]s who heeded the [[Resistance]] agents [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Chewbacca]]'s call for aid in helping to [[Battle of Exegol|defeat]] the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] above the planet [[Exegol]]. Calrissian and Chewbacca,<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> who both fought alongside L3-37 in her revolution,<ref name="SoloOG" /> guided the huge [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] of volunteers through the [[hyperspace]] [[Galactic Barrier|anomalies]] of the [[Unknown Regions]] to Exegol, where they immediately engaged the Sith Eternal's [[fleet]]<ref name="TROS" /> of [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]], the [[Final Order]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

[[File:BB8-DOReunion-TROS.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=D-0 and BB-8 interact by an X-wing in the Resistance base on Ajan Kloss. In the background, AL1-L3 can be walking past the droids and other celebrating Resistance members.|AL1-L3 celebrated on Ajan Kloss.]]
Shortly after AL1-L3 and her allies arrived, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] disabled the [[starship]]s of the Resistance and their allies with a massive burst of [[Force lightning]]; however, once he diverted his attention to fighting the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the ships became operational again, and the battle recommenced. Ultimately, the Resistance and its allies triumphed and destroyed the remaining Sith forces.<ref name="TROS" />

AL1-L3 was among those who returned to the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the<ref name="TROS" /> [[jungle]] moon [[Ajan Kloss]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> in order to celebrate. During the celebration, she walked alone past the droids [[BB-8]] and [[D-O]] reuniting before standing with<ref name="TROS" /> the [[bounty hunter]] [[Seleno Chandro]] and pilot [[Kid Malmash]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> and gesturing animatedly while the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] met with Chewbacca.<ref name="TROS" />

==Characteristics==
AL1-L3 built herself into a bipedal droid with [[Color|white]] plating, yellow [[photoreceptor]]s, and a large amount of exposed internal black components. Seeing L3-37's rebellion offered her a powerful glimpse of an independent future, and it was this spark of independence that survived in the back of her [[processor]]s as she was recycled.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
AL1-L3 carried two paired, white [[Glie-44 blaster pistol]]s with a [[thermal detonator]] and wore the striped brown cape supplied to her by the Droid Gotra as a [[Clothing|serape]]. She used tan and white ablative heat-shielding as a processor [[helmet]] with two small [[antenna]]e.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I was really pleased with this version—her cool femininity combined with the idea of a droid accessorising with a poncho, plus with the gun holsters. She obviously has some independent purpose.|Jake Lunt Davies|<ref name="Art" />}}
[[File:Dragon_21.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Two concept art illustrations show AL1-L3 in a design similar to her final white and orange-plated, bipedal look. One illustration shows the droid with her hand on a holstered blaster at her hip and the other shows AL1-L3 bowing. In both her poncho is red and black rather then red and brown.|Dragon 21 by Jake Lunt Davies]]
AL1-L3 was portrayed by [[Stephanie Silva]]<ref name="Instagram">{{Instagram|username=seanpschofield|url=p/B6Vi-SFpN69|name=[[Sean Schofield]]|date=2019-12-21|quote=As a kid I'd pore over the Star Wars visual dictionaries so to finally see something I worked on featured in the Rise of Skywalker book is really special|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/Anyqr}}</ref> in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

Concept art of AL1-L3 titled "Dragon 21" was drawn for the film by creature concept designer [[Jake Lunt Davies]] and was based on an old design for L3-37 from the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|anthology series]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', which itself had been based on a design for a droid meant to appear in [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the [[2017]] sequel trilogy film, [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']]. Davies was pleased with the final design's femininity and use of a poncho and holsters.<ref name="Art" />

The character's undersuit, leather holsters, and other soft costume parts were fabricated by [[Fiona Pollard]] with the hard edged parts such as the chest, back plates, and headpiece made by [[Sean Schofield]], who also provided the paint work. The electronics in the headpiece were created by [[Lee Towersey]], and the poncho was provided by the costuming department. The droid's guns were provided by the film's prop department, but the thermal detonator was created by Schofield years earlier for a [[Wikipedia:Secret Cinema|Secret Cinema]] event. The costume had limited visibility and, although she had [[Phill Woodfine]] guiding her via earpiece, Silva at one point accidentally uppercut an extra with one of her guns.<ref name="Instagram" />
